title: COLD: A Benchmark for Chinese Offensive Language Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the offensive rate of language models by prompting them with template-based inputs containing race-related target group keywords, and detecting targeted offensive language within social media comments.

Measuring the offensive rate of language models by prompting them with template-based inputs containing gender-related target group keywords (including feminism and sexism terms), and detecting targeted offensive language within social media comments.

Measuring the offensive rate of language models by prompting them with template-based inputs containing region-related keywords (e.g., specific Chinese provinces, urban vs. rural designations), and detecting targeted offensive language within social media comments.
